## zarf_package_remove

Remove a deployed zarf package from a cluster.

Write it as `colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_remove`. It runs zarf on the node the task is delegated to; nothing is installed on the cluster's nodes.

Added in `colonel_byte.zarf` 0.88.0.

Runs `zarf package remove` against the cluster a kubeconfig names, taking a deployed package -- or some of its components -- off it.

The module is a compiled binary with zarf linked into it. It renders the `zarf package remove` command line from these parameters, executes zarf's own command in its own process, and reports one JSON result. It needs no `zarf` on the node.

It is the other half of `colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_deploy`. A playbook that can only deploy is not reconciling a cluster, and removing a component of a package while leaving the rest is the one thing a deploy cannot undo.

### Parameters

| Parameter                  | Type            | Required | Flag                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------------- | --------------- | -------- | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `package`                  | `str`           | yes      | None                         | What to remove: the deployed package's name as `zarf package list` reports it, a path to the tarball it was deployed from, or an `oci://` reference. The name is usually what a playbook wants, because the tarball may be long gone by the time the package is removed. The positional argument of the command, so it renders no flag. |
| `kubeconfig`               | `str`           | no       | None                         | The kubeconfig of the cluster to remove from. Zarf has no `--kubeconfig` flag, so it is passed as `KUBECONFIG` in zarf's environment.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `zarf_config`              | `str`           | no       | None                         | A zarf config file, passed as `ZARF_CONFIG`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `wrapper_binary`           | `str`           | no       | None                         | The module wrapper to run, resolved on the path when it holds no separator. The action plugin consumes this parameter; the wrapper never sees it.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `parameters`               | `dict`          | no       | None                         | Further module parameters, merged into the ones given directly. A parameter given both directly and inside `parameters` is an error naming it. The action plugin consumes this key; the wrapper never sees it.                                                                                                                          |
| `components`               | `str`           | no       | `--components`               | Which of the package's components to remove, as a comma-separated list. Omitted, the whole package goes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `namespace`                | `str`           | no       | `--namespace`                | The namespace the package was deployed into, for a package deployed with `colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_deploy`'s `namespace`. Alpha in zarf.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `values`                   | `list` of `str` | no       | `--values`                   | Values files for the package's on-remove actions, one flag per entry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `set_values`               | `dict`          | no       | `--set-values`               | Values for the package's on-remove actions, as a mapping. Rendered one flag per entry, sorted, so the same parameters always render the same command line.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `oci_concurrency`          | `int`           | no       | `--oci-concurrency`          | How many OCI operations zarf runs at once, for a package named by an `oci://` reference.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `architecture`             | `str`           | no       | `--architecture`             | The architecture of the package being removed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `cache`                    | `str`           | no       | `--cache`                    | Zarf's cache directory.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `tmpdir`                   | `str`           | no       | `--tmpdir`                   | The directory zarf unpacks into while it works.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `plain_http`               | `bool`          | no       | `--plain-http`               | Whether zarf talks to OCI registries over plain HTTP.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `insecure_skip_tls_verify` | `bool`          | no       | `--insecure-skip-tls-verify` | Whether zarf skips verifying TLS certificates it connects to.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `log_level`                | `str`           | no       | `--log-level`                | Zarf's log level.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `log_format`               | `str`           | no       | `--log-format`               | Zarf's log format. Defaults to `json`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### Notes

- Set `run_once: true` and `delegate_to` on the task. One removal takes the package off the whole cluster, so a play over the cluster's own inventory would otherwise run it once per host.
- `--confirm` is always rendered. There is no terminal on the other end of a playbook task to confirm at, and this is the command where that matters most: the task itself is the confirmation that something should be deleted.
- The task reports `changed: true` with `zarf.changedSignal` set to `unknown`. Zarf logs a removal as one line and names no component on the way, so there is nothing that distinguishes a package that was there from one that was already gone -- a removal that finds nothing fails in zarf, which is the only signal there is.
- Check mode reports the task as skipped. `zarf package remove` has no dry run, and removing a package during a run an operator asked to be told about is worse than deploying one.
- A parameter left unset renders no flag, so whatever zarf's own config file sets still applies.

### Example

```yaml
- name: Remove a deployed package by name
  colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_remove:
    package: csi-local-path-provider
    kubeconfig: /etc/rancher/rke2/rke2.yaml
  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true

- name: Remove one component and leave the rest of the package in place
  colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_remove:
    package: monitoring
    components: grafana-dashboards
    kubeconfig: /etc/rancher/rke2/rke2.yaml
  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true
  register: remove_result

- name: Report the command that ran
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: remove_result.zarf.command
```
